goal: Reduce low-signal noise surfaced by the v4 workspace so attention lands on items that need a decision today. Tier 1 of 2 from the diagnostic at /Volumes/lex1t/OC-workspace/memory/engram-cleanup-diagnostic.md.
userProblem: Today view and other entity list views render entities with null or placeholder titles as the literal string 'Untitled'. This produces confusing rows the user cannot act on. Separately, V4Today renders 8 sections of equal weight on first paint, so 12 idle projects and 25 recent notes visually bury the 3 actually-due follow-ups. Result: high cognitive load, missed follow-ups.
whyNow: User reported too much noise to focus on important work. Diagnostic identified these two surfaces as the highest-leverage low-risk fixes. Task 1 (Untitled fallbacks) already shipped in commit af3dd806 on main. Remaining work is task 2 (V4Today collapse) and task 3 (React-side regression test that complements the pytest regression landed with task 1).

tasks.title: Drop 'Untitled' fallback strings in MCP and UI
tasks.description: ALREADY COMPLETED. Replaced `entity.title || 'Untitled'` style fallbacks in mcp_server/v4_formatters.py (13 sites) and 7 UI view components with `(no title)` plus entity id and type via a shared entityTitleLabel() helper in ui/src/utils/entityDisplay.js. Added tests/unit/test_mcp_v4_formatters.py with 3 regression tests asserting 'Untitled' is not in formatter output. All 6 pytest tests pass, npm run build passes, grep returns zero matches.

React list rows render entity id and type placeholder when title is null
cd ui && npm run build passes

tasks.title: Default-collapse low-signal sections in V4Today
tasks.description: V4Today currently renders 8 sections on first paint. After this change, the four low-signal sections — Projects without open tasks, Stale projects, Suggested archival, Recent notes — are collapsed by default and reveal via a 'Show N more' disclosure. The remaining four — Focus now, Overdue, Due today/follow-up, Stuck — remain visible at top. Cap the Projects without open tasks list at 5 visible items (with 'View all 12' link if more exist). Recent notes stays in the same screen but is collapsed, not removed. This is presentation only — the underlying `/api/v4/today` payload is unchanged. Keyboard accessibility required: collapse controls must be focusable buttons (not divs), and aria-expanded must reflect state.
acceptanceCriteria: On first render of V4Today with mixed-state data, Projects without open tasks / Stale projects / Suggested archival / Recent notes are collapsed (not visible in DOM or hidden via aria-hidden)
Each collapsed section shows a summary line ('12 idle projects — show') on a focusable button and expands on click/Enter/Space
Projects without open tasks renders at most 5 items by default with a 'View all N' link that expands the list
Focus now, Overdue, Due today/follow-up, and Stuck sections render fully as before
ui/src/views/V4Today.test.jsx adds a test that confirms collapsed initial state for the four low-signal sections

tasks.title: Add React-side regression test that 'Untitled' string does not appear in rendered DOM
tasks.description: Task 1 already added Python-side regression coverage in tests/unit/test_mcp_v4_formatters.py. Add the parallel React coverage: a Vitest test that renders a fixture list with at least one null-title entity through V4EntityList (or any view using entityTitleLabel) and asserts the literal string 'Untitled' is not in the rendered DOM. Also assert the placeholder includes the entity id and type so the disambiguation contract is enforced on the UI side too. Test file: ui/src/views/__tests__/untitled-render.test.jsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Test renders V4EntityList with a fixture containing an entity with title: null
Assertion: 'Untitled' is not in the rendered text
Assertion: '(no title)' is in the rendered text
Assertion: the entity id is in the rendered text
